methodology.scope: Public deployed normal home-page navigations only; no login/auth, mutations, artificial API probes or database fixture.
methodology.cache: disabled via CDP; fresh anonymous context for every navigation
methodology.proxy: Default Chrome system proxy behavior, CDP proxy phase recorded; no no-proxy flag and no system changes
methodology.network: Actual network/CDN/TLS plus CDP-added 40 ms latency, 10 Mbps download and 5 Mbps upload; no CPU throttle
methodology.guards: Only exact Render/Pages/Supabase origins allowed; non-GET/HEAD/OPTIONS denied; all other origins blocked including Google.
methodology.readiness: load, then four cards and session role marker, then networkidle; no input/click/focus
methodology.lcp: Last observed LCP candidate, not field p75; no synthetic interactions.
methodology.bytes: CDP loadingFinished.encodedDataLength sum for allowed origins including HTML/API/images; unfinished/failed responses may be incomplete.
methodology.sanitization: Only public origin labels/pathnames and safe cache/content/server/CORS headers; no raw query values, cookies, authorization, response bodies, tokens or personal data.

interpretation.sampleLimit: n=3 per deployment, sequential convenience observations. Not p75, statistical equivalence, isolated hosting attribution or a cold-start test.
interpretation.proxyConfounder: Render document proxy phases: 821.77 / 861.30 / 866.06 ms. Pages: 0 / 847.84 / 876.55 ms. One Pages navigation avoids the resolver phase; FCP medians are identical at 1856 ms despite unequal sample proxy phases. No extra navigations or proxy configuration changes were made.
interpretation.networkLimit: Actual public network/CDN/TLS plus CDP-added 40 ms latency and capped 10 Mbps / 5 Mbps. Browser cache is empty; CDN cache state is not cleared or controlled. API was already in use before measurement; no cold instance was deliberately triggered.
interpretation.lcpAndBytes: All six last LCP candidates are the facade image at 225120 visible pixels, Render PNG versus Pages WebP. Compare combined deployed frontend/assets/CDN behavior, not only hosting. Rendering and total traffic reductions remain observed values with these limitations.
interpretation.safeHeaders: All six HTML responses use h2 and br. Render HTML reports CF-Cache-Status DYNAMIC with public,max-age=0; Pages HTML reports public,max-age=0,must-revalidate and no CF-Cache-Status header in these observations. Catalog API reports no-store and DYNAMIC.
